purpose: Explicit current resource-contract candidates. Historical scored runs used predecessor task versions; no automatic score transfer.

input_leakage.evidence: Maintenance inspection compared public setting/fixed background with target SSA section 3: no target-specific PCA/head-weighted subspace recipe, target formula/table/result directly supplied. This is not exhaustive semantic contamination acceptance.

judge_behavior.evidence: Native task judge calibration/trajectory audit remains separate; no new model call in this migration.

rights.evidence: Original source cache and PDFs are service-only; blanket redistribution and derived material rights remain unapproved.

runtime.evidence: Frozen CPU dependency image exists; candidate task budget and isolated broker configuration explicitly set. No real executor trajectory on this migrated task has been accepted.

source_semantics.evidence: Candidate migration preserves the original problem and fixed independent inputs; task-target leakage inspected, but original eight-paper summary facts were not comprehensively re-audited in this migration. Shared R2 coverage remains limited.

resources.disk_semantics: per-run total writable tmpfs: /work 80%, /tmp 20%; charged to container memory; dependency image and read-only inputs excluded. Collection counts all /work files AND directories except top-level .broker and .process-*; file-byte total excludes directories and archive metadata. Hard deadline may discard uncaptured tmpfs; only already captured controller receipts are retained, no periodic backup promised.
resources.resource_scope: Limits govern this task execution; this is not an empirical future-experiment cost estimate.
resources.tool_call_metric: controller broker API calls; direct worker CPU/file operations remain bounded by container resources, not counted as API calls
